design_brief.overview: Official Korean presidential website with authoritative yet accessible design. Full-width editorial layout combining deep navy institutional branding with modern gradient accents. Content-first approach emphasizing news, schedules, and presidential media.

visual_identity.color_strategy: Monochromatic navy palette (#00194a / #00205c) as institutional anchor, with white and near-black (#111111) for content areas. A single vivid purple-blue-pink gradient banner breaks the sobriety for the schedule section, signaling modernity. Accent blue (#0080fb) reserved for interactive elements.
visual_identity.typography_strategy: Dual-font system: Pretendard (variable sans-serif) handles 95% of text from 10px captions to 68px hero headlines with weight variation (300-800). Nanum Myeongjo (serif/명조) used exclusively for emotionally resonant section titles at large sizes (55-64px), creating a literary, dignified contrast.
visual_identity.spacing_philosophy: Generous whitespace. 8px base grid. Large section gaps (60-130px vertical). Content breathes within full-width containers. No visible max-width wrapper — layout uses edge-to-edge backgrounds with internal content padding.

layout_blueprint.structure: Single-column vertical stack of full-width sections. No sidebar. Background color alternation (white → gradient → navy → white → dark) creates visual rhythm without explicit dividers.
layout_blueprint.hero: Split layout: left text (68px headline + description + pill CTA) / right editorial image. 10-slide Swiper carousel with numeric counter and playback controls.
content_sections: Schedule banner: vivid gradient background, today's events, auto-carousel
Twin CTA blocks: side-by-side colored rectangles with quote + title + arrow
Briefing carousel: horizontal card slider, serif section title, nav arrows
Bento photo/video grid: 2-column asymmetric layout, overlay text on images, play buttons on videos
layout_blueprint.navigation: Minimal horizontal nav (5 items) on white bar. Logo left, nav center, accessibility toggle right. Sticky on scroll.
layout_blueprint.footer: Ultra-minimal: address + copyright centered on light gray background. Scroll-to-top button.

interaction_patterns.carousels: Swiper.js throughout — hero (10 slides), schedule (3 slides), briefing (6 cards). All have prev/pause/next controls and numeric indicators.
interaction_patterns.buttons: Primary: rounded pill (border-radius 28px), navy bg (#00205c), white text. Secondary: text + right arrow (→). Opacity-based hover feedback (0.75).
interaction_patterns.cards: Briefing cards: title (2-line clamp) + description (2-line clamp) + date. Clean, no borders, separated by column gap.
interaction_patterns.accessibility: Font-size adjustment toggle (가가), skip-to-content links, semantic HTML structure (banner, nav, contentinfo roles)

brand_voice_guide.tone: Presidential authority softened by public service warmth. Formal Korean (합니다/습니다 endings) but emotionally direct.
brand_voice_guide.headlines: Large, declarative, multi-line Korean statements. Mix of policy and personal emotional appeals.
brand_voice_guide.cta_language: Understated: '자세히보기' (view details) rather than aggressive calls-to-action. Arrow icons provide directional cues.
brand_voice_guide.content_rhythm: Latest news → today's schedule → policy CTAs → briefings → photo/video moments. Temporal freshness emphasized through dates on every item.

reproduction_notes.border_radius: 28px for pill buttons, 50% for circular controls
reproduction_notes.swiper_config: Multiple instances with numeric counters and play/pause controls
reproduction_notes.image_treatment: Full-bleed photos with text overlay. Video thumbnails with centered play button circle.
